list_intro: Groups and channels where you're an admin with access to Aegis:
list_empty: No chats yet. Add Aegis to a group or channel as an admin — or, in a group where Aegis already is, send «پیکربندی» or config to get its panel.
gone: ℹ️ Aegis is no longer in that chat.
cant_check: ⚠️ Telegram didn't let Aegis check your status in {title}. Try again in a moment.
not_admin: 🔒 You're not an admin of {title} (any more), so you have no access to its panel.
no_access_level: 🔒 Your access to Aegis in {title} is set to None. Ask the chat owner.
root_rights_ok: 🛡 Aegis has every permission it needs.
root_rights_unknown: 🛡 Aegis's permissions haven't been checked yet — press Re-check.
root_outside: ⚠️ Admins not appointed through Aegis: {n} (see 👮 Admins)
perms_fix: To fix it: open the chat → Administrators → Aegis and switch on what's missing. Only the chat's admins can change a bot's rights — Aegis can't do it itself.
admins_legend: ✅ Aegis can edit or remove these admins. ⚠️ Telegram doesn't let Aegis touch admins it didn't appoint.
admins_outside_hint: To bring the {n} ⚠️ admin(s) under Aegis: the chat owner removes them as admins in Telegram, then appoints them again here with «➕ Appoint an admin».
basic_no_admins: ℹ️ In a basic group Telegram doesn't let bots appoint admins. It has to become a supergroup first.
block_no_rights: You need full access and Telegram's «Add new admins» right (or to be the owner) to manage admins.
bot_cant_promote: Aegis doesn't have the «Add new admins» right in this chat. Grant it first (🛡 Permissions).
pick_prompt: 👤 Who should become an admin of {title}? Tap «👤 Choose a user», forward any message from them, or send their numeric ID. They must already be a member of the chat.
pick_bad: ❓ Choose a user with the button, forward a message from them, or send their numeric ID.
pick_hidden: 🕶 Their privacy settings hide who sent that forwarded message. Use «👤 Choose a user» or their numeric ID.
pick_username_unknown: ❓ Telegram doesn't let bots look people up by @username, and Aegis hasn't met this one. Use «👤 Choose a user» or their numeric ID.
pick_not_member: ❌ {name} isn't a member of this chat. They must join it first.
block_creator: The chat owner can't be changed.
block_not_via_aegis: {name} was appointed outside Aegis — Telegram doesn't let Aegis edit or remove them.
block_higher: You can't change {name}: their access level is equal to or higher than yours, and you didn't appoint them.
edit_hint: Tap a right to switch it on or off. 🔒 = you or Aegis don't have it, so it can't be given or taken away — it stays as it is.
edit_promote_warning: ⚠️ «Add new admins» lets them appoint admins themselves — those won't be appointed through Aegis.
edit_expired: This editor has expired. Open the admin again.
right_locked: 🔒 You or Aegis don't have this right, so it can't be given.
edit_empty: Choose at least one right. To take all rights away, use «Remove as admin».
confirm_promote: Appoint {name} as an admin of {title} with these rights?
demote_q: ⬇️ Remove {name} as an admin of {title}? They stay in the chat as a regular member and lose their Aegis access.
done_promote: ✅ {name} is now an admin — appointed through Aegis.
outside_info: ⚠️ {name} was appointed outside Aegis. Telegram lets a bot edit or remove only the admins it appointed itself, so Aegis can't change this admin's rights or remove them, and anti-betrayal protection and admin restrictions can't act on them. To fix it: the chat owner (or whoever appointed them) removes them as an admin in Telegram, then appoints them again here with «➕ Appoint an admin».
access_legend: Full: everything, including admins and access · Settings: change settings · View: read only · None: no access. Only admins have access. By default «Add new admins» → Full, «Change info» → Settings, other admins → View. Only the owner can give Full; Full admins can change lower levels.
access_full_q: Give {name} Full access? They'll be able to manage admins and other admins' access.
lang_title: 🌐 Language of {title} Messages Aegis posts in this chat are in: {name}
reminder_on: 🔔 Reminders about admins not appointed through Aegis are on.
reminder_off: 🔕 Reminders are off (the panel still shows those admins).
block_level: You can only set levels below your own — only the owner can give Full.
root_audit: 🕵️ Audit Mode is ON: automatic punishments are only reported.
need_restrict: You need Telegram's «Ban users» right in this chat for this.
bot_cant_restrict: Aegis doesn't have the «Ban users» right in this chat.
